content:
Apple has released the first developer beta of iOS 27.2, kicking off a new round of iPhone software testing. Here are the highlights of this update.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 Details

iOS 27.2 beta 1 is now available for download by developer testers.

You can go to the Settings app, select General, then tap Software Update, and choose iOS 27 Developer Beta under Beta Updates to install.

What's New in iOS 27.2 beta 1?

Below are some of the changes we've found so far in iOS 27.2 beta 1.

  • The redesigned Health app first unveiled by Apple at the iPhone 18 Pro launch event has officially arrived in this beta.
  • Dual-camera recording mode comes to Group FaceTime.
  • Siri AI language support adds French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Apple TV app profile feature comes to iPhone.
  • In Apple Podcasts, "Up Next" has been renamed to "Latest Episodes"; the "Continue Playing" row has been moved directly below "Latest Episodes"; episode lists now feature a background color matching the show.
  • Apple Music has reduced the use of icon colors as label colors within the app.

We'll continue testing and updating this article. If you spot something new in iOS 27.2 beta 1, let us know in the comments or at tips@9to5mac.com.
